name: Crowley Tradeport Logistics Campus (Tradeport Distribution Center) - Jacksonville FL

fieldNotes.facility: 1350 Tradeport Dr, Jacksonville FL 32218 (TDC IV, built 1989, ~102,409 sq ft single warehouse). Crowley's Jacksonville Tradeport Distribution Center, on the city's northside in the International Tradeport / Imeson industrial park, adjacent to Jacksonville International Airport with access to JAXPORT's Talleyrand/Blount Island/Dames Point terminals. Address + coords resolved via web research (CommercialCafe/LoopNet TDC IV record: 30.478125, -81.653030) and confirmed by satellite: the geocode lands on a single large NW-SE-oriented white-roof warehouse with auto parking on the NW/front side and a loading-dock apron on the SE face. METRIC UNIT: warehouse dock doors counted normally; trailerParkingCapacity = trailer drop/staging slots on the dock apron.
fieldNotes.truckGate: FALSE. This is an open multi-tenant industrial park, not a fenced/guarded campus. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint at the property line; the dock apron is reached from a shared park access drive on the NW/front. The SE dock apron is bounded by a drainage canal, with no perimeter truck gate visible in 2026 Maxar satellite or 2022-2023 Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE. No staffed booth at any property entrance; the only structure on the dock apron is a small dock canopy mid-wall (two blue trailers/containers backed under it), not a guard booth. With no gate, remoteGs is also false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Band 25-50 (estimate ~26), LOW confidence. The SE long wall faces a continuous wide concrete/asphalt apron running the building's full ~200 m length; a regular dock-door rhythm is partly visible (door bays + dock-leveler shadows), but tree/building shadow obscures much of the wall. NOTE a discrepancy: Crowley press material cites '12 dock-high doors' for the Tradeport DC, but the 1350 Tradeport building face is long enough for materially more positions; counted conservatively from imagery and flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 0-10. Only ~2 trailers/containers staged at the apron in the imagery; this is an active dock apron, not a dedicated drop-trailer lot. trailerParkingCapacity ~12 = trailers the apron could hold.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: TRUE. The dock apron plus the shared park access drive easily hold a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: FALSE as audited (single 102k sq ft building). It sits inside a larger multi-tenant industrial park (several neighboring warehouses), so 'campus' in the facility name refers to the park, not a multi-building Crowley campus; flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE. A single dock face on the SE wall handles both directions.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Urban. Inside Jacksonville's Tradeport/Imeson industrial fabric near JAX airport and the I-95/I-295 interchange.
fieldNotes.railServed: FALSE. No rail spur runs into the parcel; the SE boundary is a drainage canal.
fieldNotes.entryLanes/exitLanes: Estimated 1/1 from a single shared access; not separately markable at the open park entrance.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium. Location positively resolved to 1350 Tradeport Dr and the correct single warehouse confirmed by satellite + Street View (front office face, dock apron, canal boundary). Confidence held at medium (not high) because Street View does not reach the private dock face, the dock-door count is partly shadow-obscured and conflicts with Crowley's stated 12-door figure, and 'campus' framing vs. the single audited building is ambiguous.
